0.description: No visible issues detected. The plant appears vigorous and green.

1.description: Concentric ring lesions (target spots) on lower leaves. Caused by Alternaria solani.

2.description: Water-soaked lesions with white mold on the underside of leaves. Caused by Phytophthora infestans.

3.description: White powdery spots on leaf surface reducing photosynthesis.

4.description: Yellowing (chlorosis) of lower/older leaves progressing upward.

5.description: Clusters of small insects on new growth, causing leaf curl and honeydew deposits.

6.description: Tiny stippling marks on leaves with fine webbing underneath. Caused by Tetranychus urticae.

7.description: Small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit. Caused by Xanthomonas spp.
